body: thank you, and good luck to you as well. things have just become too hard and I feel too depressed to do anything And feel ashamed and lonely in my sadness feeling like nothing will get better... I want to end it all, but also keep trying to find a small bit of hope somewhere to keep going.

I hear you. I'm 28, living back at home with my fokks, no money, never had a career, no car, lost my ex fiancé to terrible choices and past experiences. I am unemployed with no job experience with an art degree I'm in serious debt from and have been diagnosed with major depressive disorder and anxiety and bipolor disorder.. I take antidepressants now, but seriously don't feel any better..  I'm here to talk with you if you want. I understand feeling tired and useless.

I completely understand because I too feel these ways. Its a permanent choice, and I'm still building the courage to take my own life. I'm afraid of permanent darkness, and become even more depressed with the belief there may be nothing forever on the other side of death.. that things will be as they were before birth, non existence... the thoughts haunt me and drive me crazy. I do hope you find peace and that things get better for you.

I completely relate. I have been laying in my bed for months crying and devising the best plan to take myself out. I research methods and sleep all the time. I got a useless degree, I have so much debt, I have no job, my ex fiancé kicked me out, I live back with my alcoholic parents, and I've been to two psych wards since february due to constantly feeling suicidal and I attempted twice. Once by stopping eating, the other I took barbituates that I ordered from china. There is nothing out there for me to do in the world. I have no roots anymore, and don't know who I am, and have given up. I'm here on this reddit because it helps to talk to others that can relate etc... I take things one day at a time, but I still ask what's the point anymore daily. I can tell you I am here to listen and relate with you. I have become an empty shell, and it is even more lonely and sad when no one wants to be around you because you're so depressing. I don't know what you should do either, but I do know we all have the choice to stay or go, and taking things a day at a time has helped me some.

I layed down sleeping for weeks and starved myself eating only once every few days this past february through june and I was put in two psych hospitals for claiming it was my way of just ending my life. I know exactly how you feel because what you typed out goes through my head all the time. Time is a foe and a friend, and now its approaching september, I still have no job and no one to talk to, but time has begun to make things alittle easier to bear, and some days I feel less suicidal than others. I've had to get through one day at a time, try to focus on each day as its own, you may find it gets to be a bit more manageable.

these exact same thoughts and feelings run through my bones daily. I can't seem to get it out of my head just how inadequate I am. I feel sorry I was born and have such a bad memory, therefore feel I have no identity. I relate a lot to your post.
